name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: Gives your AI coding assistant a memory, so it remembers what you were working on and decided last time instead of starting from zero every session.
buyer: An indie developer or small engineering team running long-lived projects with AI coding assistants, who is tired of re-explaining project context and past decisions every new session.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer uses it to keep multiple client codebases' context separate and persistent, cutting onboarding time back into each project every morning.
A dev tools startup offers a hosted, managed version of this memory layer (already hinted at with its 'CMEM Pro' hosted tier) as a subscription add-on for teams.
An agency running many parallel AI-assisted projects standardizes on it so handoffs between developers don't lose project history.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted/managed memory service with team sharing and higher limits, as the project itself is already doing with its Pro tier.
Sell setup-and-tuning consulting for teams who want this wired into their specific AI agent workflow.

steal_this: If you run a dev-tools newsletter or community, write the definitive 'why your AI agent forgets everything and how to fix it' guide using this tool, and sell the hosted tier as an affiliate.
